justreplay.configuration.title: Just Replay settings
justreplay.hud.hint: G editor  J play  K keyframe  O path  H hide
justreplay.list.title: Replays
justreplay.list.name: Name
justreplay.list.empty: No replay yet. Press F8 in game to record.
justreplay.editor.title: Replay editor
justreplay.editor.curve.tip: Path shape. Through keys passes through every keyframe, Bezier rounds every corner for the smoothest motion, Linear goes straight.
justreplay.editor.timing.tip: Constant speed: the camera travels the whole path at a constant speed from the first to the last keyframe, middle keyframe times do not matter. Keyframe times: each keyframe is reached at its own time.
justreplay.editor.ease.tip: Smooth start and stop of a constant speed path.
justreplay.editor.showpath.tip: Draw the camera path and keyframes in the world.
justreplay.editor.marker.name: Marker name
justreplay.editor.help: Space play  arrows seek  Del delete
justreplay.actor.title: Edit actor
justreplay.actor.name: Name / skin
justreplay.actor.head: Helmet
justreplay.export.title: Export video
justreplay.export.resolution.label: Resolution
justreplay.export.resolution.render: Rendered at %s x %s, whatever the window size
justreplay.export.resolution.scaled: Too large for the graphics card: window size scaled to %s x %s
justreplay.export.failed: Video export failed, see the .log file
justreplay.export.error.keyframes: Add at least two camera keyframes
justreplay.export.error.ffmpeg: Cannot run FFmpeg (%s). Install it or set its path.
justreplay.export.error.nothing: Add cuts, or at least two keyframes to the selected path camera
justreplay.editor.cam.rename.label: Camera name
justreplay.editor.cam.delete.confirm: Delete this camera and its cuts?
justreplay.editor.cam.target.tip: Follow the entity you are viewing through or looking at, else the recording player.
justreplay.editor.cam.not_path: The selected camera is not a path camera
justreplay.editor.preview.tip: Look through the cut track, or through the selected camera when there are no cuts (key O).
justreplay.editor.cut.add.tip: Make the selected camera live from the play head. Keys 1 to 9 cut to camera 1 to 9, also while playing.
justreplay.editor.cut.blend.tip: Transition into the selected cut: 0 is a hard cut, otherwise a smooth blend over that many ticks.
justreplay.editor.cut.end.tip: End the cut track at the play head; press again at the same time to end it with the replay.
justreplay.editor.cut.none: No cuts: the selected camera is used
justreplay.editor.voices.tip: Play the recorded voice chat and include it in video exports.
justreplay.editor.actor.action.tip: Type of the action added to the selected actor at the play head.
justreplay.model.pick.title: Choose a Blockbench model
justreplay.model.pick.empty: No .bbmodel file in the models folder yet
justreplay.button.record.tip: Also with the %s key in game
justreplay.list.sort.name: Name
justreplay.list.empty.key: No replay yet. Press %s in game to record one.
justreplay.editor.sidebar.tip: Show or hide the side panel
justreplay.editor.export.tip: Render the cut track (or the selected path camera) to a video
justreplay.editor.save.tip: Save now. The project is also saved after every change.
justreplay.editor.key.tip: Add a keyframe to the selected path camera at the play head (K)
justreplay.editor.marker.tip: Add a marker at the play head
justreplay.editor.zoom_in.tip: Zoom in (Ctrl + wheel on the timeline)
justreplay.editor.zoom_out.tip: Zoom out (Ctrl + wheel on the timeline)
justreplay.editor.cam.row.tip: Select this camera. Key %s cuts to it at the play head.
justreplay.editor.cam.new_static.tip: New fixed camera placed at your view
justreplay.editor.camera.add.tip: Add a keyframe at the play head from your current view (K)
justreplay.editor.delete.tip: Delete the selected keyframe, cut or action (Delete)
justreplay.editor.camera.update.tip: Move the selected keyframe to your current view
justreplay.editor.goto.tip: Go to the selected keyframe, or to where the camera is at the play head
justreplay.editor.camera.recorder.tip: Move your view to the recording player
justreplay.editor.cam.set_view.tip: Place this camera at your current view
justreplay.editor.follow.mode: Where the camera stays around its target
justreplay.editor.lens.tip: Applies to the selected keyframe of a path camera, or to the whole camera otherwise
justreplay.editor.actor.player.tip: Add a player actor at your view
justreplay.editor.actor.entity.tip: Add an entity actor (any entity id) at your view
justreplay.editor.actor.model.tip: Add a Blockbench model actor at your view
justreplay.editor.actor.none: No actor yet. Actors are players, mobs or Blockbench models you place and animate in the replay.
justreplay.editor.actor.select: Select an actor to edit its keyframes and actions.
justreplay.editor.actor.keyframe.tip: Place the actor at your view at the play head
justreplay.editor.actor.edit.tip: Name, skin, equipment, pose, model and actions
justreplay.editor.actor.lane.tip: Select an actor to see its keyframes and actions here
justreplay.editor.marker.none: No marker yet. Add one here, or press %s while watching.
justreplay.editor.export.help: The video covers the cut track when there are cuts, else the selected path camera from its first to its last keyframe. Press Esc during an export to cancel it.
justreplay.help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
justreplay.help.click: Select, or move the play head
justreplay.export.ffmpeg.tip: Path to ffmpeg, or just ffmpeg when it is on the PATH
justreplay.toast.buffer_off.hint: Enable the replay buffer in the Just Replay settings
justreplay.editor.mode.tip: Simple shows only what you need to make a video. Advanced shows every tool. Switching never loses your work.
justreplay.editor.simple.camera.help: Fly to a spot, look where the video should look, then add a camera point. Move the play head, fly somewhere else and add another: the camera glides from point to point.
justreplay.editor.simple.point.tip: Remembers where you are and where you look, at the time of the play head (K)
justreplay.editor.simple.point.first: First point added. Move the play head and add another one.
justreplay.editor.simple.point.row.tip: Jump to this point: the play head and your view go there
justreplay.editor.simple.play_path.tip: On: you see what the video will show. Off: you fly freely to place things.
justreplay.editor.simple.show_path: Show the path in the world
justreplay.editor.simple.show_path.tip: Draws the camera route and its points in the world while you edit
justreplay.editor.simple.smoothness.tip: Curve goes exactly through every point. Bezier rounds the corners for the softest motion.
justreplay.editor.simple.constant.tip: On: the camera moves at the same speed all along. Off: it reaches each point exactly at its time.
justreplay.editor.simple.more_cameras: This project uses several cameras. Switch to Advanced to edit them.
justreplay.editor.simple.add.player.tip: A player wearing the skin of any Minecraft name
justreplay.editor.simple.add.mob.tip: A villager, a zombie, a wolf... pick one in the list
justreplay.editor.simple.none: No character yet. Add one, then click where it should stand.
justreplay.editor.simple.select: Click a character in the list or in the world to direct it.
justreplay.editor.simple.place.tip: Aim with the crosshair and click where it should stand. Wheel turns it, Esc cancels.
justreplay.editor.simple.crosshair.tip: Moves it to the block in the middle of your view, at the play head
justreplay.editor.simple.face.tip: Turns it towards you, at the play head
justreplay.editor.simple.does: What it does from the play head
justreplay.editor.simple.walk.tip: Click where it should walk to; it starts walking at the play head
justreplay.editor.simple.follow.tip: It walks after the person you pick, and runs when far behind
justreplay.editor.simple.sit.tip: Click a chair, stairs, a slab or any block: it sits on it
justreplay.editor.simple.bed.tip: Click a bed: it lies down in it
justreplay.editor.simple.stop.tip: Stops sitting, sleeping, following or waving and stands still
justreplay.editor.simple.markers.help: Markers are bookmarks on the timeline: click one to jump there.
justreplay.editor.simple.export.help: The video goes from the first to the last camera point, with the settings below.
justreplay.editor.simple.export.tip: Makes the video now, with the usual settings
justreplay.editor.simple.export.missing: Add at least two camera points first (Camera tab).
justreplay.editor.simple.export.nothing: Nothing to export yet: add two camera points
justreplay.help.pick: Select the actor under the mouse in the world
justreplay.help.place.center: Hold: snap to the block center
justreplay.place.keys: Click: confirm   Wheel: turn (Shift: fine)   Ctrl: block center   Esc: cancel
justreplay.help.audio_split: Split audio clips at the play head
justreplay.audio.files.none: No audio yet. Put OGG or WAV files in the audio folder, then come back to this tab.
justreplay.audio.file.tip: Audio file of the audio folder to place on the timeline
justreplay.audio.add_clip.tip: Places the file at the play head on the selected track (a track is created if needed)
justreplay.audio.convert: %s file(s) in a format that cannot be read (MP3...): convert them to OGG or WAV
justreplay.audio.formats: OGG and WAV (any rate, mono or stereo, up to 10 minutes). MP3 is not supported: convert it to OGG or WAV.
justreplay.audio.game.volume.tip: Volume of the recorded game sounds, in the preview and the export. Hold Shift for fine steps.
justreplay.audio.game.mute.tip: Silences the recorded game sounds; the voices keep their own switch in the Scene tab
justreplay.audio.ducking.tip: Lowers the game sounds and the voices while an audio clip plays (voices are ducked in exports only)
justreplay.audio.tracks.none: No audio track. Add a clip or a track to start.
justreplay.audio.track.row.tip: Select the track: new clips go on it
justreplay.audio.track.name: Name
justreplay.audio.track.delete.confirm: Delete this track and all its clips?
justreplay.audio.trim.tip: Position in the file where the clip starts or ends. Drag the clip edges on the timeline too. Hold Shift for fine steps.
justreplay.audio.speed.tip: Playback rate of the clip; the pitch follows
justreplay.audio.loop.tip: Repeats the trimmed part for the loop length
justreplay.audio.split.tip: Splits the clip at the play head (S)
justreplay.audio.duplicate.tip: Copies the clip right after itself (Ctrl + D)
justreplay.audio.lane.tip: %s: drag clips to move them, drag their edges to trim them, Shift to move freely
justreplay.toast.buffer_ram: Instant replay keeps the last %s min in RAM
justreplay.toast.buffer_ram.detail: About %s to %s MB of memory. Lower it in the settings if needed.
justreplay.fx.enabled.tip: Renders the filters, transitions and fades in the preview and the export. Off bypasses the whole chain.
justreplay.fx.preview.tip: Transitions, fades and camera filters show while the camera preview is on; global filters always show
justreplay.fx.scope.tip: Global filters apply to every shot; camera filters only while that camera is live
justreplay.fx.preset.tip: Ready-made look: adds its filters to the stack, they stay editable
justreplay.fx.add.tip: Filter to add to the stack
justreplay.fx.none: No global filter. Add a filter or a look.
justreplay.fx.toggle.tip: Turn the filter on or off
justreplay.fx.unknown: Unknown filter (made by a newer version).
justreplay.fx.lut.none: No LUT in the luts folder. Put a .png there: a 1024x32 strip or a 512x512 grid.
justreplay.fx.lut.reload.tip: Reads the LUT files again after you changed them
justreplay.fx.param.tip: Drag to set the value at the play head. The key adds or removes a keyframe at the play head; Shift + click on it clears the keyframes.
justreplay.fx.keys: %s keyframes: values follow them over time
justreplay.fx.keys.none: Fixed values; click a key to animate a parameter
justreplay.fx.fade.tip: Fade at the start or end of the export range. Hold Shift for fine steps.
justreplay.fx.transition.select: Select a cut on the timeline to set its transition.
justreplay.fx.transition.first: The first cut opens the track: use the fade in instead.
justreplay.fx.transition.tip: How the picture changes at this cut; it starts at the cut
justreplay.fx.duration.tip: Length of the transition. Hold Shift for steps of one tick.
justreplay.audio.crossfade.tip: Overlapping clips of this track crossfade with an equal power curve instead of adding up
justreplay.audio.fade_curve.tip: Shape of the fade in and fade out
justreplay.action.hint.dance: style|bpm|beat tick: bounce, pump, hands, wave, shuffle, headbang, jump, dj, hakken, jumpstyle
justreplay.overlay.help: Titles, labels and stickers that live in the world: hang them on a player, an actor, a block or a point in the air. They show in the preview and in video exports.
justreplay.overlay.add.text.tip: Adds a text at the play head, then place it with the crosshair
justreplay.overlay.add.image.tip: Adds an image from the images folder at the play head, then place it with the crosshair
justreplay.overlay.row.tip: Select to edit; its bar on the timeline drags to move it, its ends change when it shows
justreplay.overlay.select: Select an overlay to edit it.
justreplay.overlay.place.tip: Aim at an entity, a block or empty air (Ctrl: always a free position) and click
justreplay.overlay.anchor.missing: Its entity is not in the world at the play head
justreplay.overlay.anchor.recorder.tip: Follows the recording player, above the head
justreplay.overlay.anchor.actor.tip: Follows one of your actors, above the head
justreplay.overlay.anchor.camera.tip: A fixed position three blocks in front of the camera
justreplay.overlay.facing.tip: Camera: always turned towards the camera. Fixed: keeps its own yaw, pitch and roll. On the face: lies flat on the block face
justreplay.overlay.through.tip: Drawn over blocks and entities in front of it
justreplay.overlay.fade.tip: Shift: one tick at a time
justreplay.overlay.param.tip: Drag to change. The key adds or removes a keyframe at the play head (Shift: clear them all)
justreplay.overlay.keys.none: No keyframes: the values hold the whole time
justreplay.overlay.text.edit.tip: starts a new line, & followed by a code sets a colour or a style (&6 gold, &l bold)
justreplay.overlay.text.title: Overlay text
justreplay.overlay.text.label:
Text (
: new line, &6: gold, &l: bold)
justreplay.overlay.text.help:
Codes: &0 to &f colours, &l bold, &o italic, &n underline, &m strikethrough, &r reset, 
 new line.
justreplay.overlay.size.tip: Height of a line in blocks (Shift: fine)
justreplay.overlay.plate.tip: A rounded glass plate behind the text
justreplay.overlay.image.none: No images yet. Put PNG or JPG files in the images folder, then come back to this tab.
justreplay.overlay.image.reload.tip: Reads the image files again, after editing them
justreplay.overlay.image.broken: This file cannot be read (see the log)
justreplay.overlay.lane.tip: Texts and images: drag a bar to move it, drag its ends to change when it shows
justreplay.overlay.place.keys: Click: confirm   Wheel: distance in the air (Shift: fine)   Ctrl: free position   Esc: cancel
justreplay.actor.skinfile.tip: Player actors only. Click to cycle through the PNG skins (64x64) of the justreplay/skins folder. A skin file replaces the skin of the account named above.
justreplay.actor.slim.tip: Arm model of the skin file: slim (Alex) or classic (Steve).
justreplay.audio.kinds.tip: Volume of one kind of game sound in the replay and in exports, from 0 to 400%. Footsteps are quiet in the game, so they start at 200%.
